reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Dispute ticket volume roughly doubled from a ~600/month baseline to 1180-1260/month starting August 2026 (E-07), with disputes attaching predominantly to bills built from ACTUAL meter reads rather than ESTIMATED substitutions (1785 vs 1240, E-01). This pattern is consistent with a billing import validation rule change around August producing incorrect bills on actual-read accounts (H-BILLING-RULE-CHANGE), ruling out tariff change (E-02), field manual-read gaps (E-01, E-03), and slow dispute response (E-06) as the driver.
reasoning_quality_informational.v2_root_problem: Dispute ticket volume roughly doubled from a ~600/month baseline (Jun/Jul 2026) to 1180-1260/month (Aug/Sep 2026) (E-07), caused by billing import validation rule BV-17 (deployed 2026-08-01, E-12), which compares raw AMI register values to 12-month m3 consumption history with unit_scaling "none"; this misreads firmware-v4.2 meters' 0.1-m3-unit readings (rolled out 2026-06, E-13) as roughly 10x true consumption, causing 1184 legitimate high-consumption actual reads to be falsely rejected (REJECTED_HIGH_CONSUMPTION) and fall back to estimated billing (E-11), producing incorrect bills that drive the dispute surge.
reasoning_quality_informational.ideal_final_problem: BV-17 validation rejects valid firmware-v4.2 AMI reads (unit-scale mismatch on H-MDMS-BILL) and substitutes estimates.
